question: A train passes two bridges 400 m and 295 m long in 75 seconds and 60 seconds. respectively. If the length of another train is 325 m running at the speed of 97.2 km/h. How much time (in seconds) will both trains take to cross each other running on parallel tracks in the same direction?
solution:
**Given:**

A train passes two bridges 400 m and 295 m long in 75 seconds and 60 seconds. respectively

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/time

When two objects going in the same direction then their relative speed will be difference of their individual speeds

When a train crosses a bridge/train then it will cover the length of that bridge/train along with its own length

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the train be x m

According to the question,

(400 + x)/(75) = (295 + x)/(60)
